classification.difficultyReason: Establish similarity using two given angle pairs, match corresponding sides and calculate an unknown length.

content.prompt:
Prove that $\triangle ABC$ is similar to $\triangle DEF$.

Find $x$.

spec.description: Two unfilled triangles side by side. ABC has C upper left, A right and B below A; DEF has E upper left, D below E and F right. Source decorative blue outlines are rendered in house black. User-approved correction replaces the inconsistent numeric angle labels with matching single arcs at C/F and double arcs at A/D.
spec.mathematics: CA=5 cm, AB=3 cm, ED=x cm, DF=4 cm. Matching single arcs give angle ACB=DFE; matching double arcs give angle CAB=FDE. Correspondence A-D, B-E, C-F. Explicit user-approved source correction, 22 October 2026: remove the incompatible numeric 20/120-degree givens, retaining their equality relationships, all side lengths, AAA proof and x=12/5 cm. Original PDF/key remains immutable evidence. Approval: approved-review-source-corrections-20261022.json. This editorial decision grants no content or geometry acceptance.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied vertex labels and side lengths remain; matching angle marks replace the approved inconsistent numeric givens. No calculated lengths are shown.

answer.short:
$\triangle ABC\sim\triangle DEF$ (AAA); $x=\frac{12}{5}=2\frac{2}{5}\text{ cm}$.

Two corresponding angle pairs are equal, and $\frac{DE}{AB}=\frac{DF}{AC}$.
answer.worked:
The matching angle marks give
$$\begin{align*}\angle ACB&=\angle DFE\\\angle CAB&=\angle FDE\end{align*}$$
Therefore $\triangle ABC\sim\triangle DEF$ by AAA similarity, with $A\leftrightarrow D$, $B\leftrightarrow E$ and $C\leftrightarrow F$.
Corresponding sides have the same ratio:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{DE}{AB}&=\frac{DF}{AC}\\\frac{x}{3}&=\frac{4}{5}\\x&=3\times\frac{4}{5}\\x&=\frac{12}{5}=2\frac{2}{5}\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$
